name: Power / Thermal Sanity Eval
summary: Is power draw and thermal state within range?
purpose: Evaluate power/thermal sanity: power draw sane, thermals within range.
assignment_instructions: Sanity-check the power draw and thermal state from the telemetry. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
